mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/9fb8aaf1f0dd-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/9fb8aaf1f0dd-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_94F5 모델링 준비: TP 단위 코호트·라벨·특성·분할 테이블 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json, hashlib, gzip
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_94F5.json").read_text())

# 0. 무결성 확인
man = json.loads((D / "MANIFEST.json").read_text())
for t, m in man["tables"].items():
    raw = gzip.open(D / m["file"]).read()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == m["sha256_csv"], t

P = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

# 1. TP 격자 (anchor=admit)
tp = A[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time", "discharge_time", "discharge_status", "unit"]].merge(
    pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tp["tp"] = tp.admit_time + tp.offset_h * H
tp = tp.merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")

# 2. KDIGO 판정 함수: 각 크레아티닌 측정(collect 기준)에 대해 같은 입원 내 직전 48h/7일 값으로 판정
cr = L[L.test == "creatinine"].sort_values(["admission_id", "collect_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)

def kdigo_flags(df):
    """df: 한 입원의 크레아티닌 (collect_time 정렬). 각 행이 KDIGO 기준을 만족하는지."""
    t = df.collect_time.values; v = df.value.values; out = np.zeros(len(df), bool)
    for i in range(len(df)):
        prev48 = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))]
        prev7d = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))]
        out[i] = (len(prev48) and v[i] - prev48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prev7d) and v[i] >= 1.5 * prev7d.min())
    return out

cr["kdigo"] = np.concatenate([kdigo_flags(g) for _, g in cr.groupby("admission_id", sort=True)])
crg = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}
labg = {k: g for k, g in L.groupby("admission_id")}

def per_tp(r):
    c = crg.get(r.admission_id, cr.iloc[:0]); lb = labg.get(r.admission_id, L.iloc[:0])
    known = lb[(lb.report_time >= r.admit_time) & (lb.report_time <= r.tp)]   # report_time 기준, tp 시점에 알 수 있는 값
    ck = c[(c.report_time >= r.admit_time) & (c.report_time <= r.tp)]
    # 제외: tp까지 보고된 크레아티닌 중 KDIGO 충족 (판정 기준값은 tp까지 보고된 값만 사용)
    excl = bool(len(ck)) and kdigo_flags(ck.sort_values("collect_time")).any()
    # 결과: [tp, tp+48h] 채취분 중 KDIGO 충족 (기준값: 같은 입원 tp-168h 이후 채취분)
    w = c[(c.collect_time >= r.tp) & (c.collect_time <= r.tp + 48 * H)]
    y = bool(w.kdigo.any())
    # 진단용: tp 이전 채취·tp 이후 보고된 AKI 샘플 존재
    pend = bool(c[(c.collect_time < r.tp) & (c.report_time > r.tp)].kdigo.any())
    def f(test, agg, start=r.admit_time):
        s = known[(known.test == test) & (known.report_time >= start)].sort_values("report_time").value
        if agg == "count": return len(s)
        if not len(s): return np.nan
        return {"min": s.min(), "max": s.max(), "last": s.iloc[-1]}[agg]
    return pd.Series(dict(
        excl_aki_known_by_tp=excl, aki_48h=y, n_cr_in_outcome_window=len(w), pending_aki_at_tp=pend,
        cr_min_adm=f("creatinine", "min"), k_last=f("potassium", "last"), bun_last=f("bun", "last"),
        cr_max_48h=f("creatinine", "max", r.tp - 48 * H), cr_last=f("creatinine", "last"),
        hgb_min=f("hemoglobin", "min"), n_cr=f("creatinine", "count")))

tp = pd.concat([tp, tp.apply(per_tp, axis=1)], axis=1)
# n_admissions_to_tp: 환자 전체 이력에서 admit_time <= tp
adm_times = A.groupby("patient_id").admit_time.apply(lambda s: np.sort(s.values))
tp["n_admissions_to_tp"] = [int(np.searchsorted(adm_times[p], t.to_datetime64(), side="right"))
                            for p, t in zip(tp.patient_id, tp.tp)]

# 3. 코호트 플래그 (설계서 기준 + 준비 단계 진단 플래그)
tp["incl_adult"] = tp.age >= 18
tp["in_hospital_at_tp"] = tp.discharge_time > tp.tp                       # 설계서에 없음: 확인 필요
tp["discharged_within_window"] = tp.discharge_time < tp.tp + 48 * H        # 결과창 중도 퇴원/사망
tp["cohort_design"] = tp.incl_adult & ~tp.excl_aki_known_by_tp.astype(bool)
tp["cohort_proposed"] = tp.cohort_design & tp.in_hospital_at_tp

# 4. 분할 키: family_id 결측(80%)은 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 (설계서 그대로는 불가 → 확인 필요)
tp["split_group"] = tp.family_id.fillna("PT_" + tp.patient_id)
groups = np.sort(tp.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
tp["split"] = np.where(tp.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp", "discharge_time",
        "discharge_status", "incl_adult", "excl_aki_known_by_tp", "in_hospital_at_tp", "discharged_within_window",
        "pending_aki_at_tp", "n_cr_in_outcome_window", "cohort_design", "cohort_proposed", "aki_48h"] + \
       [c for c in feat if c not in ("unit", "sex", "age")] + ["unit", "sex", "age"]
tp[cols].to_csv(OUT / "tp_dataset.csv.gz", index=False)

# 5. 요약 (라벨 분포/측정 빈도는 확인 목적, 성능 계산 아님)
s = {}
s["n_tp_grid"] = len(tp)
s["n_after_discharge"] = int((~tp.in_hospital_at_tp).sum())
s["n_after_discharge_in_design_cohort"] = int((tp.cohort_design & ~tp.in_hospital_at_tp).sum())
s["n_cohort_design"] = int(tp.cohort_design.sum()); s["n_cohort_proposed"] = int(tp.cohort_proposed.sum())
c = tp[tp.cohort_proposed]
s["n_excluded_aki_known"] = int((tp.in_hospital_at_tp & tp.excl_aki_known_by_tp.astype(bool)).sum())
s["cohort_proposed_no_cr_in_window"] = int((c.n_cr_in_outcome_window == 0).sum())
s["cohort_proposed_discharged_within_window"] = int(c.discharged_within_window.sum())
s["cohort_proposed_died_within_window"] = int((c.discharged_within_window & (c.discharge_status == "died")).sum())
s["cohort_proposed_pending_aki_at_tp"] = int(c.pending_aki_at_tp.sum())
s["cohort_proposed_pending_aki_label_pos"] = int((c.pending_aki_at_tp & c.aki_48h.astype(bool)).sum())
s["family_id_missing_frac_patients"] = float(P.family_id.isna().mean())
s["n_split_groups"] = int(len(groups)); s["n_test_groups"] = len(test_groups)
s["split_tp_counts"] = c.split.value_counts().to_dict()
s["leak_check_patient_in_both_splits"] = int(tp.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique().gt(1).sum())
s["by_unit"] = c.groupby("unit").agg(n=("aki_48h", "size"), event_rate=("aki_48h", "mean"),
                                     mean_n_cr_window=("n_cr_in_outcome_window", "mean"),
                                     no_cr_frac=("n_cr_in_outcome_window", lambda x: float((x == 0).mean()))).round(4).to_dict("index")
s["by_offset_n"] = c.offset_h.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()
s["missing_frac"] = c[[f for f in feat]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict()
(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
print(json.dumps(s, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
